candidates.structural_interaction: Wood generating Fire cross-polarity — reach nourishing warmth and opening direction
candidates.k2_overview: Your Wood moves as the Sage: living shelter, the teaching tree. Care in you grows canopies, patience wide enough for slow learners, roots that hold ground for whole families. What you know, you plant in people. It is the gentlest power in the system. Just keep one sunny patch that grows things purely for you.

k2_functional.mind: You think in growth arcs: what this person could become with the right seasons.
k2_functional.expression: You teach by cultivation: questions as water, encouragement as light.
k2_functional.bonds: You hold people like rooted ground: steady nutrition, decades of shade.
k2_functional.action: You act by tending: consistent small care that compounds into forests.
k2_functional.body: Your body thrives on green routine: nature, gentle movement, seasonal patience with yourself.

k2_domain_readings.Knowledge: Your knowledge is arboreal: living, branching, taught best by walking someone through the grove. You learn to pass on. Teaching is how your roots drink.
k2_domain_readings.Shelter: Your shelter is canopy: people rest under your patience and grow in your shade. The forest never asks who waters the oldest tree. Arrange your own rain.
k2_domain_readings.Mother: The mother-thread is orchard-deep: a nurturing figure who planted daily, or soil you had to enrich alone. Either way you became the gardener. Tend your own roots with the same hands.
